title: Number of islands
statement: Given a grid of '1' (land) and '0' (water), count the islands: groups of land cells connected horizontally or vertically.
hints: Every unvisited land cell starts a new island; flood-fill it so it isn't counted again.

solution.explanation: Scan cells; each unvisited '1' is a new component, and a DFS/BFS marks all of it. Use an explicit stack in Python: a 200 × 200 all-land grid recurses 40,000 deep.
